indices.provider: Rating and Valuation Department, HKSAR Government
notes: Indices are territory-wide and quality-adjusted; geographic neighborhood indices are not published in RVD domestic all-class series.
RVD domestic average rents/prices are published for Hong Kong Island, Kowloon and New Territories, by class; these are not neighborhood indices.

Class A saleable area <40 sqm (<430.6 sqft); Class B 40-69.9 sqm (~430.6-752.4 sqft). User 400-600 sqft (37.2-55.7 sqm) spans upper Class A/lower Class B and does not map exactly to either full class.
Jul-Sep 2026 index figures are provisional. Latest CSV data take priority over potentially older monthly supplement tables.
Indices measure changes with quality held constant using rent or price divided by rateable value; changes in simple average psf can reflect transaction mix.
Rent averages exclude rates, management and other charges. Sale analysis excludes primary sales and tenanted domestic sales.
Regional annualRentToPriceRatioPct is an indicative ratio of separate average rent and sale samples, not the official RVD market yield and not a matched-property investment yield.
Official RVD domestic yield series latest accessible period is Aug 2026. Class A 3.5%, Class B 3.1%, provisional. Properties in rental and sale analyses can differ.

notes.title: Get a bank valuation before committing
notes.text: Standard bank mortgage limits are a maximum 70% LTV and 50% debt servicing ratio. These are ceilings, not an offer: confirm your bank valuation, income assessment, down payment and any mortgage-insurance eligibility. Test repayments at a higher rate.

notes.title: Budget the acquisition costs
notes.text: Add current ad valorem stamp duty, legal and agency fees, moving and refurbishment costs to the purchase price. Use the IRD calculator for the actual price and execution date; the rates changed on 26 February 2026.

notes.title: Turn gross yield into a cash-flow budget
notes.text: Deduct vacancy, management fees, rates, government rent, insurance, repairs and tax. Individual Property Tax is generally 15% of net assessable value after the permitted deductions and 20% statutory allowance; it is not 15% of gross rent. Financing is a separate cash-flow cost.

notes.title: Check title and the permitted use
notes.text: Have your solicitor review the current land search, mortgages, encumbrances, occupation permit, Deed of Mutual Covenant and any unauthorised alterations. Ask for the Property Information Form before signing.

notes.title: Price in major building works
notes.text: Ask the manager and owners’ corporation for inspection notices, outstanding orders, recent meeting minutes, reserves and planned levies. Buildings aged 30+ served with a mandatory inspection notice must undergo prescribed inspection and necessary repairs.
notes.source_title: Buildings Department · Mandatory Building Inspection Scheme

notes.title: Review the lease on the specific property
notes.text: Check the Government lease term, restrictions and extension notices with your solicitor. Applicable leases have a statutory extension mechanism, but do not treat every lease as automatically identical or ignore government rent.

notes.title: Compare the whole tenancy deal
notes.text: Check whether rent includes management fees, rates and government rent. Agree the deposit, break and renewal clauses, repairs, inventory and rent-free period in writing. Inspect noise, daylight, damp, air-conditioning and the actual bedroom layout.
notes.source_title: EAA · Enter into a tenancy agreement

notes.title: Calculate net sale proceeds before listing
notes.text: Request the lender’s redemption figure and any early-repayment charge. Deduct outstanding mortgage, agreed commission, legal fees and other sale costs. Check exclusive-agent terms, existing tenancy and vacant-possession timing before accepting an offer.
notes.source_title: EAA · Estate agency agreement for sellers

decision_framework.headline: Use the tracker to shortlist inspections, not to predict capital gains.
decision_framework.buy: First filter by an affordable total acquisition cost and suitable floor plan. Compare recent same-estate, same-size transactions, then use estimated net cash flow and building condition to rank the remaining options.
decision_framework.rent: Rank the all-in monthly cost of verified two-bedroom flats, then commute, layout, condition, tenancy flexibility and landlord terms. Estate-wide psf is a screening guide, not a quote for a particular flat.
decision_framework.missing_history: If a neighbourhood lacks a consistent rental history, display “trend unavailable”. A snapshot cannot establish rising or falling rents. Never substitute the Hong Kong rental index as that neighbourhood’s own index.
decision_framework.future_updates: Build a local repeatable series from deduplicated two-bedroom 400–600 saleable-sq-ft observations. Preserve observation dates, transaction/listing status, sources, sample counts and coverage; show gaps when the sample is insufficient.
decision_framework.yield: 12 × monthly rent / purchase price is gross indicative yield. Ratios of estate-wide rent and sale psf are screening proxies, because observations may cover different flats and periods. Do not call them matched or district-wide yields.
decision_framework.ranking: Use transparent filters and user-selected priorities. Avoid a single unexplained “best investment” score; no universal district is best without commute, budget, holding period, risk tolerance and financing.

researchMethodology: salePsf: 28Hse body adjusted past-90-day transacted estate average; South Land uses simple average and has only one sale.
saleYearAgoPsf is source-reported; derive saleYoY as salePsf/saleYearAgoPsf-1, but not a constant-quality official neighborhood index.
rentalYoY is unavailable. Price-change percent displayed near sale psf has unclear comparison window and is NOT used as monthly or annual change.
grossYieldComputed = rentPsf*12/salePsf*100; indicative estate cross-sectional proxy, not a matched unit return or net yield.
Unit listing observations are asking prices, not transactions. Sale and rent examples may be different units.

mapSources.coordinates: Estate-specific map markers from 28Hse/Centaline; per-estate coordinateSource retained. Approximate estate locations, not entrances or individual flats.

fx.method: Cross rate = ECB KRW per EUR / ECB HKD per EUR from the same published day. Full ratio retained; display rounds to 2 decimals.
notes: Reference rate, not a bank or remittance quote; excludes spreads/fees.
Currency conversions do not change the underlying HKD property prices or yields.
An unchanged HKD price can have a different KRW equivalent when FX moves.
Latest published reference date can precede retrieval on weekends, public holidays or before the next ECB publication.
